title: Mixed Event — Screaming?! Welcome to the Forest of Wolves! — Episode5 Kohane The Wolf's Gone Wild!

meta.Event: Screaming?! Welcome to the Forest of Wolves!
meta.Episode: Episode5 — Kohane The Wolf's Gone Wild!
meta.Event Outline: The Miya Girls School Festival is fast approaching. Kohane was thinking about inviting the rest of Vivid BAD SQUAD and wondering what they could do throughout the day, but her class, 1-A, decided to do something An's not very fond of... A haunted house!

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wh-Why's that thing chasing after me?!
Is this entire place supposed to be the haunted house?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I-I've just gotta keep running...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff... An's too fast...!
I can't catch her...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<And there's a ton of people...
It's so easy to lose sight of her...!>

rows.Speaker: Student
rows.Line: Huh?! What's that thing?!

rows.Speaker: Student
rows.Line: Did one of the other classes make that?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Uh oh... People are gonna probably freak out if they see me, so I'm gonna hide for a bit...!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Kohane!
An just ducked into that classroom!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
That one?!
An!
Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, hello!
Welcome to the Flufftacular Animal Cafe☆...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: *Scream*

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I-I-I-I-Ichi!!!
Help! Something scary just walked in!!!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Huh? Whoa!!
Wh-What is that...?! A zombie wolf...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That is pretty scary...

rows.Speaker: Guest
rows.Line:
Whoa, that thing's pretty terrifying...!
Is it supposed to be some kind of zombified animal?

rows.Speaker: Guest
rows.Line:
Does it work here or something?
But it looks pretty grotesque!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: S-Sorry! I'm not here to hurt anyone! I just came in to...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That voice... Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: H-Haruka...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(It is her.
And she sounds pretty worried. I wonder what's going on.)

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line:
*Cry*
I'm scared!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But first, we need to calm everyone down...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hey, Wolfie!
I think you're in the wrong forest!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Shouldn't you be at Class 1-A?
Are you here to advertise your haunted house? It's called “Little Red Riding Hood and the Young Goats' Slightly Scary Forest Adventure”, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh...?!
Y-Yes!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Class 1-A is doing a haunted house!
I-It's really fun, so we hope you'll stop by later!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Th-Thank goodness...!
They're just here to advertise!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting another class to surprise us like that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Class 1-A's haunted house is meant to be enjoyable for everyone. You don't have to be a hardcore thrill seeker to have fun, so please check it out.

rows.Speaker: Guest
rows.Line: Oh, it was just a different class advertising... Still, that mask looked pretty scary...

rows.Speaker: Guest
rows.Line: Let's go check it out afterwards!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Th-Thank you so much, Haruka...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You're welcome, but...
Why did you rush in...? Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Is this where you agreed to meet An?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She jumped in a second ago and ran out after she saw you follow her. I think she went towards the AV room...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
...! Thank you, Haruka!
I promise to pay you back later for this!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Wait, Kohane!
If you run out with that thing on your head...!
AV Room

rows.Speaker: Third Kobuta Sister
rows.Line: “...Mr. Okami turned himself in to the police and repaid his debt to society!”

rows.Speaker: Eldest Kobuta Sister
rows.Line: “The end.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe. We did it, Honami!
That went really well!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, it did!
Thank you for working so much with me during practices, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Eep...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Oh no! I forgot...!
This is where Emu's class is doing their show...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I-I'm so sorry!!!

rows.Speaker: Spectator
rows.Line:
Wh-What was that...?!
It looked like a horrifying wolf...

rows.Speaker: Spectator
rows.Line: Was it supposed to appear at the end of the show...?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Th-That wasn't in the script, was it...?
Emu, what should we do...?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“Mr. Okami has been rehabilitated!
However, this world is full of other baddies and evil creatures... Like mean Mr. Wolf...!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: “We, the three Kobuta Sisters, will continue fighting to put them all back on the right path!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
“You can do it!
We believe in you!
I hope you'll all keep rooting for us!”

rows.Speaker: Spectator
rows.Line:
Huh...?!
Oh, now I get it. That's how it's supposed to end.

rows.Speaker: Spectator
rows.Line: So the grand finale was only the beginning... That's pretty cool...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Th-That was amazing, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks!
But what happened to Mr. Wolf...?
Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thanks for your purchase!
We hope you enjoy the rest of the festival!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. It was so nice of Ena and the others to stop by.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, let's keep this momentum going by selling even more!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Sorry about that, Kohane!
Seriously, where'd An go...?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I don't see her either... Do you think she's still in the building?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Kohane, watch out!
You might trip on one of these signs!>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, I'll be... Wah!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Sob*
Just as you warned me...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: H-Hey, are you okay...?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sh-Shizuku?! Airi?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Huh...?!
I ended up in front of their sweets stall...?!)

rows.Speaker: Guest
rows.Line: Wh-What is that thing?

rows.Speaker: Guest
rows.Line: It cut in line too...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
O-Oh no...!
I'm causing another big fuss...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That voice... Kohane, is that you?
What a cute wolf's head♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: C-Cute...? I'm not sure how cute it is, but... I'm so sorry...! I didn't mean to cause you so much trouble...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's all good. I mean, accidents happen. Let's just say a wolf appeared and ate some of our things...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Oh, I know!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Help!
There's a wolf here!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wh-What?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That wolf gobbled up all the sweets we had lined up on here!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: At this rate, Shizuku, it's gonna eat everything!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
...!
Yes, you're right♪ If Mr. Wolf likes them so much, I suppose it means they're just that delicious♪

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Oh, she's right...! They look delicious and smell wonderfully sweet! Hang on... These look like pot stickers!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Th-That was incredible...!
It's so amazing what idols can do...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You should be fine now.
Just watch where you step, okay, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much! I will!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, by the way... Have you seen An anywhere?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
An?
No, I can't say we have...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I see... But thank you anyway. And again, I'm sorry! Now, if you'll excuse me!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No...!
I can't find Kohane anywhere!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: She should stick out like a sore thumb too... Oh!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Minori?
What are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Sh-Shiho!!
Are you already done checking your equipment for the night festival?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I was on my way back to see if I could help with anything... Did something happen while I was gone?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, um... The thing is...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wow, that all really happened...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah... Kohane was really looking forward to hanging out with her teammates too...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Let's split up and try to find her.
You go back inside. I'll look around the courtyard...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
We have homemade sweets here...
Hm? Shii!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Sh-Shizuku...?
Oh, right, this is your class' stall.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Airi! Shizuku!
Did you happen to see a zombie wolf run by here?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
A zombie wolf? Do you mean Kohane?
I think she went that way to go back inside the building...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Really?! Thank you so much, Shizuku!
Let's go, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: W-Wait, hold up! What happened exactly?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: S-Sorry, no time to talk! I'll explain later...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, Shizuku.
Can you send me a message if you see her again?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Yes, of course! Anything you ask, Shii!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I still can't figure out what's going on...
I feel like we should help if they're that desperate to find her...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I feel the same way.
Let's try asking our classmates to tell us if they see... Oh!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Asahina!
Sorry, can we ask you a favor?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
...?
Hinomori...?
